title: the tester runs the weekly tier: hollow re-runs and this box's own run
intention: A tester verb weekly-run re-runs every proof's hollow and runs every proof this box can run, ticketing what is new.
why: Outline 9.4.2.3.7.4 in press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt, Akien 2026-11-13: commit, hourly, daily and weekly tiers (9.4.2.3.7); 'every test failure, every orphaned file, HAS TO BE FIXED ... reds don't get lost' and 'so each run writes any new bugs'. Siblings, one per piece of outline 9.4.2.3.7, cast together on 2026-11-13: yellow ee4e874a2d61, red tickets 207c4074b3d5, scheduler 185cee7cce24, hourly 810fb2fc4a15, daily cd40ac53f08a, weekly 346c75c2f8b7, Cairn's list c811a8b1b8c7, adjudication aa2d42b15886. Build order: ee4e874a2d61 and 207c4074b3d5 first, then 185cee7cce24, then 810fb2fc4a15, cd40ac53f08a and 346c75c2f8b7, then c811a8b1b8c7, then aa2d42b15886.
traces_to: outline 9.4.2.3.7.4 (weekly: hollow re-runs and each box's own run); Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass)
how: tiers.weekly_run walks every proof with a standing hollow through hollow.py's re-run, then every proof this box can run through reseal_all, then red_tickets.

clauses.claim: a proof whose hollow build now passes it is reported red and ticketed once
a proof whose hollow still fails it is reported green and casts nothing
part 2 runs every proof the box can run, sealing through reseal_all only

decisions.text: D1: ORDER. Builds after cd40ac53f08a (shares tiers.py and device.py).

D2: VERB `weekly-run`, body none. Part 1: every proof with a sealed hollow re-runs it through hollow.py; a hollow that now passes (the proof no longer refuses a hollow build) is a red. Part 2: run-every-proof's set on this box, so each box's weekly run is its own; seals are written only by the box's tester through reseal_all (9.4.2.3.3.1, one sealer). Then red_tickets with the orphan scan on.
D3: PROOF, red-first, over a scratch repo with one proof whose hollow still fails and one whose hollow now passes.

measured.saw: hollow.py runs one ticket's hollow at a time; no verb re-runs every standing hollow
